name: synaptic-labs
description: Synaptic Labs plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: skill-crafter
plugins.description: Build, improve, modularize, validate, and package Claude Code skills the right way.

plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: Remove the signs of AI-generated writing from text: a catalog of tells with per-pattern fix protocols, false-positive adjudication, a no-fabrication rule, and mechanical gates that fail the delivery when a tell survives.

plugins.name: agentic-guardrails
plugins.description: Enterprise guardrails for agentic tools: CRUA (create/read/update/archive, never delete), bounded automatic recovery retention, agent workspace with checkout/publish, sync-aware safety for OneDrive/Drive/Dropbox, and policy-driven command/content blocking.

plugins.name: professor-synapse
plugins.description: A router that summons expert agents on demand, with persistent agent-tagged memory and a summon-gate that keeps work on-persona.
